description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.
 Team: Visit Flow, Signify Health Ireland  
 Location/Arrangement: Hybrid — 2 days per week in our Galway office (Bonham Quay) 
 
 Join a team at the heart of an R&D site for CVS Health, reimagining how care is delivered across the US. As a Software Full Stack Developer on the Visit Flow team, you'll work across the full stack — front end through back end — on modern systems that power every Signify Health visit and In-Home Evaluation, with AI as a core part of how you build: using AI tools to accelerate development, testing, and delivery, and exploring how AI can shape the products themselves. You'll get to prototype with the latest technologies, prove ideas out through proof-of-concepts, gather real feedback, and carry your work all the way into the hands of clinicians and customers — all alongside a team that enjoys working together and takes pride in a strong, collaborative culture. 
 
 This is a hybrid role requiring 2 days per week working from our Galway office. 
 About the Team 
 Visit Flow owns the Content Management System and supporting backend that form the backbone of every Signify Health visit and In-Home Evaluation. The team spans a new Web UI, backend, Progressive Web App, and shared libraries, built in close partnership with teams across Signify Health — giving content owners the ability to build and manage their own content and rules without developer involvement. 
 What You'll Do 
 Design, build, and ship high-quality code across front-end and back-end technologies, following modern engineering best practices 

 Collaborate cross-functionally with engineers, UX engineers, and architects through planning, design, development, and testing 

 Partner with the Product team to refine developer-ready, testable user stories, and contribute estimates and input to work plans 

 Prototype new ideas through proof-of-concept, gather feedback, and drive the path from idea to production 

 Participate in peer reviews, support code releases, and troubleshoot technical and application issues 

 Monitor performance and capacity across code, infrastructure, data, and message processing 

 Safeguard the security and privacy of any protected health information encountered in your work 

 What You'll Bring 
 Must-have: 
 
 3 or more years of experience in software engineering working with a mix of front and back end technologies in a product oriented, cross functional engineering team 

 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field preferred but not required 

 Strong programming skills across front- and back-end technologies (e.g. .NET, Java, ASP.NET, C#, React, or ReactNative) 

 Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work closely with engineers, product, and cross-functional partners 

 Solid SQL skills 

 Experience with CI/CD and Agile/Scrum methodologies 

 Willingness and ability to work on-site 2 days per week at our Galway office 

 Enjoyment of using AI tools (e.g. for code generation, testing, documentation, reviews) to work smarter and free up time for higher-value activities 

 Nice-to-have: 
 Experience with containerization, cloud platforms (Azure preferred), or messaging technologies (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.) 

 Exposure to caching (Redis, Couchbase) or document databases 

 Familiarity with TDD, Domain Driven Design, or Dependency Injection frameworks 

 Why Join Us 
 Work at an R&D site with a state-of-the-art facility, reimagining how care is delivered across the US 

 Deep, hands-on ownership across the full stack — no siloing between front end and back end 

 Close collaboration with 8+ teams across Signify Health, with real visibility into how your work shapes patient care 

 Join a collaborative team with opportunities to grow your skills and take on more ownership over time 

 Our Galway site is known for its strong culture — lots of social events and activities to get involved in 

 A flexible, hybrid working environment — 2 days per week in our Galway office 

 CVS Health is focused on driving business agility and growth through technology, AI, data, digital and experiential innovation — 'Digital First, Technology Forward and Data Driven' isn't just aspirational, it's how we operate. Every one of us at CVS Health shares a single, clear purpose: bringing our heart to every moment of your health. 
 Pay Range 
 The typical pay range for this role is:
€35,000.00 - €90,000.00   
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on: 05/10/2026
